mapper.sql: id, delivery_order_no, delivery_status_code,source_code,stock_code, distribution_type,goods_type, sku_count, store_name, store_code, order_quantity, order_amount,delivery_quantity, delivery_amount, distribution_quantity, distribution_amount,difference_order_no, request_order_no, hd_delivery_no, delivery_time, distribution_time, receive_time, receive_progress, auto_take_delivery_time, take_remark, org_code, biz_org_code, source_no, logistics_no, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete, remark, is_reversal, is_reversal_order, order_priority, wrh_code
mapper.update: update ord_dir_delivery set receive_progress = #{receiveProgress},updater = #{updater},update_time = now() where id = #{dirDeliveryOrderId} and delivery_status_code = #{deliveryStatusCode} and receive_progress = 2 and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and is_delete = 0

update ord_dir_delivery set receive_progress = #{receiveProgress},updater = #{updater},update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and delivery_status_code = #{deliveryStatusCode} and receive_progress = 1 and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select oddr.id, oddr.store_code, oddr.order_type_config_id, oddr.order_cycle_id, oddr.request_order_no from ord_dir_deliv_request oddr inner join ord_dir_deliv_request_delivery oddrd on oddrd.request_order_id=oddr.id where oddrd.delivery_order_id=#{id} and oddr.biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select id, store_code, order_type_config_id, short_order_type, truncation_date_time, minimum_order_amount, org_code, biz_org_code, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete from ord_dir_order_cycle where id=#{orderCycleId} and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select oddd.goods_code, sum(case when odd.delivery_status_code = 'shipped' then oddd.delivery_quantity else oddd.distribution_quantity end) as qty from ord_dir_delivery odd inner join ord_dir_delivery_detail oddd on odd.id = oddd.delivery_order_id and odd.is_delete = 0 where odd.store_code=#{storeCode} and odd.delivery_status_code in ('approved','previewApproved','shipped') and odd.create_time >= #{beginTime} and odd.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY oddd.goods_code

SELECT DISTINCT oddr.truncation_date_time, oddr.status_code FROM ord_dir_deliv_request oddr INNER JOIN ord_dir_deliv_request_detail oddrd ON oddrd.request_order_id = oddr.id AND oddrd.is_delete = 0 WHERE oddr.is_delete = 0 AND oddr.truncation_date_time >= #{startTime} AND oddr.truncation_date_time <= #{endTime} AND oddrd.distribution_type = #{distributionType} AND oddr.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode}

select id,delivery_order_no from ord_dir_delivery where store_code = #{storeCode} and is_reversal = 0 and is_reversal_order = 0 and delivery_status_code = 'received' and receive_time between #{minReceiveTime} and now() and is_delete = 0
